serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: ComplianceONE is a multi-tenant governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform that federal agencies, their contractors and commercial organizations use to manage FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171/CMMC, GovRAMP, DoD Impact Level, TX-RAMP, ITAR and AS9100 programs. It holds control implementation records, policies, procedures, evidence files, POA&Ms, risks, incidents and assessment results; generates certification documents; reads security posture from customer-authorized integrations; and offers AI drafting assistance whose output a person reviews.
